name: io.github.tonyyang0504/zbj-mcp
description: Zhubajie (deals): me, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZBJ_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: appKey (应用证书) of your approved ZOP application (open.zbj.com > 控制台).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZBJ_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Application secret (应用密钥); signs every call as uppercase hex SHA1 of secret + sorted name/value pairs + secret. Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZBJ_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: accessToken (访问令牌) from the ZOP OAuth2.0 authorisation of your 猪八戒 account.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZBJ_OPENID
environmentVariables.description: Your 猪八戒 openid (the user identifier returned by the ZOP OAuth2.0 authorisation), used by zbj.user.getUserBaseInfo.
